resources.string: Use Turnip + Zink instead of Freedreno (kgsl)
Render on the CPU (llvmpipe) instead of the GPU (virgl): slow, for comparison
Update BAR at every start, like BAR\'s PC launcher (engine, game, lobby; back to the last working version if an update fails to start). Off: only the Install / Update button updates
Open the lobby when the app starts (long-press the app icon → Launcher for this screen)
Controller support v0.8.5 in singleplayer (skirmish and the lobby\'s own games; online games play BAR\'s released game)
Sharper upscaling (Qualcomm SGSR): the game is drawn smaller than the screen and enlarged; SGSR keeps edges sharp where plain enlarging blurs them
Compare upscaling (diagnostic): SGSR on and off every 3 seconds, with a label
Lobby bridge: the app stands in for BAR\'s PC launcher, for the Replays tab, web links and skill ratings; the lobby\'s downloads go through the app (off: the Replays tab cannot list replays)
BAR touch controls: drag pans, pinch zooms, twist rotates, two fingers up or down tilt, tap then drag selects, long press gives orders. Off: the touch modes under Display

Keyboard shortcuts go to the game: Android\'s, One UI\'s and DeX\'s shortcuts (Alt+Tab, the Windows key, Ctrl+Space, the soft keyboard\'s language switch) do nothing while BAR is in front, their keys reach BAR; off = Android\'s

Optional. Sends the keyboard shortcuts Android would take for itself (Alt+Tab, the Windows key, Ctrl+Space) to Beyond All Reason while its game screen is in front. Needed only where Android does not hand them to the game by itself (before Android 16.1). It reads keys only while the game screen has focus and passes them to the game; Home, Recents, power and volume keys stay Android\'s.
